messages.content: Give me the rundown on your transfer fees.

response:
According to our public FAQ, there are no transfer fees for domestic transfers made through our online banking platform or mobile app. However, international transfers may incur a fee of up to 1% of the transfer amount, depending on the recipient's country and the transfer method chosen.

Please note that these fees are subject to change, so it's always best to check our website or contact us for the most up-to-date information.

Would you like me to clarify anything else about our transfer fees?
